name: The Ghosts — the Name, and the Hunt
tagline: Four children coined it inside hell. It is on the cover of everything.
body:
BRYN, LIVI, SERA and MADDY created the Ghosts while they were still inside St. Jonah's. The name on every profile, every house, and the whole story was made up by four kids in the middle of it, to survive with.

ORDER OF ESCAPE. Sera got out first and affirmed afterward. Livi stayed and came out with Bryn. Then Sera came back and found them both, and talked them into affirming — which they were already planning.

THE GHOST HUNT. Arc 2's first sub-arc. Rae crashed the first backyard BBQ at the apartment, and Livi went rigid, because Rae used to flirt with her inside and was doing it more shamelessly now. And the four founders worked out that if Rae survived and got out, others did too. So they went looking. They found NOVA, crippled by one of Atlas's boys, and BELLA, grouchy in a rundown garage.

The name they made to survive became the thing they went out hunting for.
rules: Coined inside by Bryn, Livi, Sera and Maddy
Sera out first, then Livi and Bryn together, then Sera came back for them
THE GHOST HUNT — Arc 2's first sub-arc, triggered by Rae walking into a BBQ uninvited
Found on the hunt: Nova and Bella
